description: A couple trades places under a raised hand and ends facing the other way.

walkthrough.line: Take one hand with {who}, left in right. The lark raises it, the robin walks under, and you trade places.
walkthrough.teach: Stand facing {who}, or side by side facing the same way, and take one hand — your left in their right, or your right in their left. The lark raises the joined hand and walks forward round the outside; the robin walks under it and round. The two of you trade places and end facing the way you came from, which is what makes this a way to change direction in the middle of a dance.
